implementation_decisions: GAME_SPEC names Waste Storage and its systems but does not dimension the section. This 12x18x4.8 m envelope and all apertures are original implementation decisions.
Four separated cells use distinct container functions; no assertion of real-world nuclear storage design or shielding certification.
Connections describe intended network roles; no fabricated transform agreement with adjacent workers.
No completed room geometry is imported or repositioned. The authoritative section starts factory empty.
Physics, networking, dose simulation and engine navmesh remain runtime handoff responsibilities, not claims of this Blender environment package.
